subject.title: message_tool_only: withheld finals stay in the agent's context as normal turns, desynchronizing agent memory from what the user saw

question: Should withheld `message_tool_only` finals remain in replay with an explicit undelivered marker, be replaced in replay by a concise notice, or be handled only through stranded-final recovery?
rationale: Source inspection proves the replay mismatch, but the durable representation affects privacy, transcript semantics, and active stranded-final recovery policy.

options.title: Add replay-visible undelivered state
options.body: Keep or summarize the private assistant text, but make later model context explicitly say the user did not receive that assistant turn.

options.title: Replace withheld finals in replay
options.body: Remove private final text from model replay and keep only a short system notice that a final was generated but not delivered.

options.title: Rely on recovery only
options.body: Treat stranded-final recovery as the product answer and accept that replay context may not separately annotate older withheld turns.

recommendation.title: Add replay-visible undelivered state
recommendation.body: Keep or summarize the private assistant text, but make later model context explicitly say the user did not receive that assistant turn.

likelyOwner.reason: This crosses core runtime, transcript privacy, and message-delivery semantics, and the strongest available history signal ties this person to the current private-final policy path.
